I had pain in my right shoulder and upper back for many months that then spread to my neck. I went to Dr Bow and Dr Earng for treatment. They were both excellent, they are very knowledgeable and very professional physiotherapists.

They advised me that part of the cause of my pain was due to tightness in my chest muscles and because I have weak core muscles. They treated those 2 issues with me and showed me exercises to strengthen them.

Dr Bow and Dr Earng speak excellent English and carefully explained all treatments to me during our sessions. Every session I did with them my pain was reduced, until eventually all the problems were fixed and the pain was gone.
